economy.icon_cadence_and_type_weights: Live Widescreen scenes only: wait between pickups 140 -> 120 ticks and empty-roll wait 240 -> 180 ticks. Every ordinary (non-boss) room table gives two of its twenty slots to the grenade gun, taken from shoes while more than one remains and otherwise from the most numerous of blades, helper, ring and smart bomb. Spray, bubble, non-stop, key and extra-life weights and boss tables remain retail.
economy.continue_penalty: Live Widescreen only: each continue (a player re-entering with a retained score) deducts 100,000 points (BCD), never below zero. Extra-life thresholds (PNEXTREP) are untouched, so a deduction cannot re-award a life. Classic retains retail.
economy.weapon_damage_and_duration: Special weapon charges per segment: spray, grenade and non-stop x2, bubble x1.6, rounded. Bubble flight bounds 7 and 24 ticks. Blades sweep wider after contact and detach on hit seven.
economy.rationale: Increased eligible enemy totals and faster releases provide more encounters and scoring opportunities with longer pickup collection windows for ordinary and boss arenas.
